topic.title: Thermal Boot Protection

body.p: To avoid hitting thermal issues and protect the system from thermal situations during pre-memory phase, BIOS will honor Override Power limit 1 (lower than TDP) and set pre-memory ratio to fit cTDP down ratio and return back to nominal ratio during BIOS_CPL.

section.title: Required Programming:
section.p:
Pre-Mem
System may power up with cTDP unit running nominal ratio, which could hit thermal limitation during MRC
BIOS will override Pre Mem ratio from nominal to cTDP down ratio once it detects there is an override of PL1 to a lower value vs Nominal TDP.

Post-Mem to BIOS_CPL
BIOS return to customer selected ratio
